parent: Frozen original Stage1 39-feature primary allocation, 16-feature common head, b472 action/risk/recovery, 944 funded evaluation intervals and SOXX final hard gate
hypothesis: An unusually large share of SOXX volume on rising rather than falling days can distinguish repair from persistent weakness beyond Stage1's 20-day price return, volatility and prior-day intraday-volume-share inputs.
single_candidate_formula: At signal date t after the completed SOXX session, sum_{i=t-19..t}(sign(adjusted_close_i/adjusted_close_{i-1}-1)*split_adjusted_volume_i)/sum_{i=t-19..t}(split_adjusted_volume_i) minus mean_{i=t-19..t}(sign(adjusted_close_i/adjusted_close_{i-1}-1)). No same-day trade-date data; 20 is frozen to match the existing Stage1 ret20 horizon. A missing/zero denominator remains missing.
source_scope: Futu NONE/RTH plus 16 explicitly flagged Yahoo SOXL whole bars, one published affine basis with exact split-adjusted shares; SOXX candidate consumes SOXX only. Existing historical retrieved bytes are not independent forward receipts.
predecision_availability_assumption: Use only completed prior US session at conservative 16:15 America/New_York, before its following trade-date 09:29 Stage1 decision. Historical vendor receipt timestamp is not certified.
checks: Qlib D.calendar/D.features source identity and exact Stage1 2011-2022 training-date coverage
all 3020 original Stage1 training dates have finite 20-day candidate after 2010 warmup
report Spearman redundancy against all original 39 features and unweighted sign control on training only
report source-only evaluation-calendar tail gap through 2026-10-07 without reading evaluation outcomes
stop: If training coverage fails, stop. Even if training passes, do not fit or account until 2026-10-07 evaluation source tail is acquired, verified and separately frozen. Do not choose sign/window by 2023-2026 returns.
